title: SAP confirms a cybersecurity incident; report: hackers obtained its staffers' authentication tokens, letting them copy and alter source code stored on GitHub (Eduard Kovacs/SecurityWeek)
summary: Eduard Kovacs / SecurityWeek: SAP confirms a cybersecurity incident; report: hackers obtained its staffers' authentication tokens, letting them copy and alter source code stored on GitHub — SAP has detected suspicious activity on GitHub, where hackers reportedly used stolen employee tokens to copy and alter source code.
